title: Planet Tweaks V3.3.9 TITAN - Tweak Test Lab Retired, Verified Low-Latency Passers Restored & Pure Zero Delay Refined
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.3.9 TITAN: (1) Retired the temporary Tweak Test Lab UI and purged all unverified/failed tweaks. (2) Kept only verified passing tweaks in their original categories (Keyboard Packet Queue Depth 25 buffer, Device Base Name, USB HID Polling Priority 3, kbdclass Start 1, FilterKeys 27, 15 Aphrodite tweaks). (3) All Pro Packs (Pure Zero Delay, Peterbot Zero Delay, All-In-One, Low Latency Input) repopulated and re-optimized with verified passing tweaks. (4) Maintained strict permanent blacklist against driver multiplexing and unstable registry hacks.
